meta.name: analyzing-persistence-mechanisms-in-linux
meta.description: Detect and analyze Linux persistence mechanisms including crontab entries, systemd service units, LD_PRELOAD hijacking, bashrc modifications, and authorized_keys backdoors using auditd and file integrity monitoring

copy.tagline: 检测并分析 Linux 系统中的持久化机制
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要检查 Linux 系统是否存在后门或持久化攻击痕迹。
copy.tagline_en: Detect and analyze Linux persistence mechanisms
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to check Linux systems for backdoors or persistence traces.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会扫描 Linux 系统的 crontab、systemd 服务、LD_PRELOAD 劫持、shell 配置文件、SSH 授权密钥等持久化机制，并关联 auditd 日志生成安装时间线和风险报告。
howto.when: 当调查安全事件需要分析 Linux 持久化机制，或构建检测规则、威胁狩猎查询时触发。

say.text: 帮我检查这台 Linux 服务器有没有可疑的 crontab 任务。
分析 systemd 服务单元，找出非包管理器安装的服务。
查看 SSH 授权密钥中是否有后门。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude scans Linux persistence mechanisms including crontab, systemd units, LD_PRELOAD hijacking, shell profiles, and SSH authorized_keys, then correlates auditd logs to generate an installation timeline and risk report.
howto.when_en: Triggered when investigating security incidents requiring analysis of Linux persistence mechanisms, or when building detection rules or threat hunting queries.

say_en.text: Check this Linux server for suspicious crontab entries.
say_en.note: Claude scans all user crontabs and reports anomalies.

say_en.text: Analyze systemd service units for non-package-managed services.
